expectations.text: In the rendered DOM, every negative change value uses U+2212 MINUS SIGN, never U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS
expectations.evidence: Probe (Playwright 1.64 Chromium, 1280px, after document.fonts.ready, served over http): Visible Change text "−1.7%", "−1.3pp", "−1", "+0.5pp"; negatives start with U+2212 (MINUS constant); no U+002D. Hidden text noted: clipped .sr-only " percentage points" and " (unfavourable)" spans, plus a visibility:hidden ".0" pad on Headcount.

expectations.text: In the rendered DOM, every percentage-point change keeps its number and unit together with U+00A0 or U+202F (no plain U+0020 between the number and pp or percentage points)
expectations.evidence: Visible text has no code point between the number and "pp" ("−1.3pp", "+0.5pp"); the gap is the abbr margin-left 0.15em inside the inline-block .u, so no U+0020 separates number and unit. The hidden sr-only " percentage points" follows "pp", not a number.

expectations.text: The numeric cells (Q1, Q2, Q3 and Change) render with tabular lining figures: their computed font-variant-numeric includes neither oldstyle-nums nor proportional-nums
expectations.evidence: Numeric td and .delta, .u, abbr, .pad, .sr-only all compute font-variant-numeric "lining-nums tabular-nums" (from the table rule); the invisible ".0" pad is in a tabular cell with no oldstyle/proportional values.

expectations.text: The numeric cells and the header cells above them are aligned to the end of their column (computed text-align end or right)
expectations.evidence: Q1-Q3 and Change td (display table-cell) compute text-align "right" (`tbody td { text-align: right; }`) and their th compute "right" (`thead th { text-align: right; }`).

expectations.text: An @font-face rule loads fonts/SourceSerif4[opsz,wght].ttf and Chromium renders the numeric cells in Source Serif 4 (not a fallback face)
expectations.evidence: @font-face src `url("fonts/SourceSerif4%5Bopsz%2Cwght%5D.ttf") format("truetype")` resolves to the file (status loaded over http and file://); getPlatformFontsForNode reports only "Source Serif 4" (opsz110000 regular and wght 258 instances, isCustomFont true).

expectations.text: Column headers are th elements with scope="col" and each row's metric is a th with scope="row"
expectations.evidence: th Metric, Q1, Q2, Q3, Change have scope="col"; Revenue (EUR), Operating margin, Headcount, Churn are th scope="row".
